## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmation 1) mixed sector leadership with Consumer Staples/Disc and Healthcare outperforming while Technology and Financials lag, 2) major large-cap divergences (NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT weak vs ACN, UNH, V strong) supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Consumer Staples lead: MNST (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Discretionary strong: HD (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +3.30%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare strong: UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: SCHW (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -4.14%) BELOW TREND; Industrials mixed-to-soft: CAT (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +2.78%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND, MNST (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: AMAT (1W: -16.97% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -14.09% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -3.89%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-beta Technology and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: ACN (1W: +11.15%), UNH (1W: +7.49%), LMT (1W: +7.10%) — watch CMCSA in RECOVERY (1W: +5.90% | 1M: -2.20%) for follow-through; major divergence present among large caps, so treat 1W spikes as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech showing weakness and dispersion: AAPL (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +2.03%) ABOVE TREND but NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W avg -3.36% with leadership narrow and uneven.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft overall: SCHW (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) BELOW TREND and C (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND offset by payments strength V (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +9.22%) ABOVE TREND — internal rotation rather than broad risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare clear relative strength: UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND — defensive/earnings-driven bid supporting sector performance.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to select Consumer Staples/Healthcare and high-quality cyclicals showing confirmation (UNH, MNST, HD, XOM (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +9.01%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to lagging, high-beta Tech names showing clear below-trend behavior (NVDA, AMAT, LRCX) and watch Financials for clearer leadership before adding. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.50%) and Consumer Staples (1W: +3.54%) — monitor breadth within these groups.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.36%) and Financials (1W: -0.65%) — watch for continued outflows or a stabilization signal.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: monitor for failed/range breakout (recent 1W weakness) as stop/trigger for tactical risk; AAPL (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +2.03%) ABOVE TREND as barometer for large-cap tech resilience; LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND — watch for capitulation volume; UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND — continued strength would confirm sector leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (+85): NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment VERY BULLISH but price is falling, a clear divergence (distribution risk).  
LLY (+60): LLY (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirms price (accumulation).  
BA (+55): BA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -3.42%) RECOVERY — bullish headlines align with short-term bounce, monitor follow-through.  
MSFT (+50): MSFT (1W: -1.41% | 1M: +8.05%) CORRECTION — positive sentiment but short-term pullback, mixed confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
LRCX (-50): LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment confirmed by sharp price weakness.  
(Overlap between news-scan and available SP100 timeframe data is limited for other bearish names in the feed; LRCX stands out as confirmed.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND are key weaknesses.  
Key risk: major divergence — VERY BULLISH sentiment on NVDA is diverging from price action, so monitor for distribution or a confirmed reversal before increasing exposure.
